description: When does the API version this code pins stop working, and what happens then? Pass provider and version pairs as your code pins them (shopify 2025-10, meta v21.0, google-ads v22, hubspot v1, twilio-flex 2.16.2, keap xml-rpc, stripe 2024-06-20). For each, returns every dated end the provider's own versioning or changelog page lists: status, end date (and whether the provider gives only a month), what happens after it (error, silent fall-forward to another version, app delisting, or unsupported), whether the failure is silent, the replacement version, the source URL with the date it was read, and a page with the details. A pair with no entry comes back with the reason: older than every listed version, no end date published yet, or a provider that publishes none (Stripe). Covers Shopify, HubSpot, Meta Graph and Marketing APIs, Google Ads and Content API for Shopping, Twilio Flex UI and Thryv's Keap XML-RPC. No API key needed.

api.description: optional, to narrow one provider to one API: admin or storefront (Shopify), graph-api or marketing-api (Meta), ads-api or content-api (Google), pipelines, rest or developer-platform (HubSpot); omit it to get every API of that provider with this version

provider.description: the provider as you would name it: shopify, hubspot, meta (or facebook), google-ads, content-api, twilio-flex, keap (or thryv, infusionsoft), stripe

version.description: the version as the code pins it: 2025-10, v21.0, v22, v1, 2025.2, 2.16.2, xml-rpc, 2024-06-20

name: agentcheck_api_sunsets
